title: Independent audit of Solana offline hourly activity and lifecycle boundary implementation
objective: Independently audit MACRO-HOURLY-LIFECYCLE-OFFLINE-016, not MACRO-HOURLY-LIFECYCLE-DESIGN-015. Verify the implementation is offline-only, its Solana hourly-profile contract and V1–V5 tests implement the approved design, report wording remains fail-closed, and no lifecycle, liquidity, conversion, sentiment, BSC, Robinhood, or live-operation claim exceeds the approved evidence boundary.
owner_authorization: Read-only independent audit except for its audit report. No Dune API/CLI/query execution, credential access, external API access, database operation, scheduling, delivery, chain-adapter activation, live-payload retention, or sentiment collection is authorized.
forbidden_actions: Do not audit MACRO-HOURLY-LIFECYCLE-DESIGN-015 in place of MACRO-HOURLY-LIFECYCLE-OFFLINE-016. The audit subject is the 016 implementation and its actual diff/test behavior.
Do not modify application code, tests, SQL blueprints, migrations, runtime configuration, task specifications other than this audit card, or any pre-existing report.
Do not execute Dune queries or use Dune API/CLI; do not access keys, cookies, credentials, external APIs, live payloads, databases, schedulers, delivery mechanisms, or chain adapters.

Do not approve implementation of real liquidity retention, token-to-pool linkage, first verified external-pool conversion, real lifecycle drawdown/survival, or sentiment values. These must remain PARK/fail-closed until a separately approved authoritative reproducible study exists.
Do not approve a valid PumpSwap pool-create event as an external listing, migration, graduation, token-level conversion, or token-to-pool linkage.
Do not modify or redefine CA creator facts, holder cleaning, creator rules, Dev behavior, wallet-cluster rules, or transaction-wallet quality rules.
Do not activate BSC or Robinhood. Robinhood must remain explicitly Uniswap v2/v3/v4 partial_coverage, and Four.meme must remain PARK.
Do not present addresses, swaps, trade legs, or hourly observations as people, buyers, demand, smart money, wallet quality, net flow, or a token trading signal.
